abilities.effect: Each creature within 20 feet of the door is targeted by *baleful polymorph* (DC 42 Will save), except the effect transforms creatures into the form of an arbiter aeon rather than that of an animal.
abilities.name: Axiomatic Polymorph

traits.name: Divine
traits.text:
This magic comes from the divine tradition, drawing power from deities or similar sources. Anything with this trait is magical.  
  
A creature with this trait is primarily constituted of or has a strong connection to divine magic.

traits.name: Transmutation
traits.text: Effects and magic items with this trait are associated with the transmutation school of magic, typically changing something’s form.

abilities.trigger: A creature moves within 10 feet of the entryway to the Hall of Wonders (area N4) without speaking the passphrase (“The History and Future of Humanity”) in Utopian

hazard.description: A Utopian glyph transforms trespassers into aeons.
hazard.disable: DC 48 Thievery (master) to drain the glyph's power harmlessly, or *dispel magic* (9th level; counteract DC 42) to counteract the glyph
hazard.name: Axiomatic Polymorph Trap

traits.name: Magical
traits.text: Something with the magical trait is imbued with magical energies not tied to a specific tradition of magic. Some items or effects are closely tied to a particular tradition of magic. In these cases, the item has the arcane, divine, occult, or primal trait instead of the magical trait. Any of these traits indicate that the item is magical.

traits.name: Trap
traits.text: A hazard constructed to hinder interlopers.
